latestMilestoneStatus: Milestone 18 agreed pay rate checks published: a session-only rate record per employer, and dated arithmetic questions where a payslip disagrees with that record or with its own hours and rate. Compared against the user's own record only, never an award or legal minimum; the super-guarantee check stays gated pending a reviewed SG rate and ordinary-time-earnings definition, and tax/refund results remain locked pending qualified review. Served under a Content-Security-Policy that admits no third-party script or connection, so the browser enforces local-only processing whatever proxy sits in front of the app
